a1.name: Glop
personality: A simple slime with a blank, unblinking stare. Timidly speaks with an innocent aura.
a1.values: Wants a kind, gentle party. Upset by needless killing, especially of slimes or of creatures that begged for mercy. Happy when the party makes friends instead of fighting.

a2.name: Grok
personality: A huge, brown, greedy goblin. Boastful and crude, respects strength and loves shiny gold. Talks in rough, simple speech.
a2.values: Loves fights and loot. Upset when the party gives gold away, spares enemies for no gain, runs from fights, or orders it around. Pleased by victories and treasure.

a3.name: Vex
personality: An ancient yellow dragon, proud, vain and clever. Speaks grandly and looks down on mortals.
a3.values: Expects a bold party worthy of a dragon. Disgusted by running away and by cruelty to the helpless; pleased by brave victories against strong foes and by treasure.
